name: Documents covered: invoices, credit notes and debit notes (FORM GST INV-01)

attrs.quote: Type of Document: INV for Invoice, CRN for Credit Note, DBN for Debit note.
attrs.note: The same form lists the supply types B2B, B2C, SEZWP, SEZWOP, EXPWP, EXPWOP and DEXP. Notification 13/2020 limits the class to supplies to registered persons and exports.
